text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted
by the MWSS as dividends to the National Government as provided for under

of Republic Act No. 7656 is authorized to be adjusted to five percent
(5%), or an equivalent amount of not less than P130.80 M for 2006.
POMA Hologram # 44998

SECTION 2. The adjusted dividend rate provided for under Section 1 is
only applicable on 2006 net earnings of the MWSS.
SECTION 3. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Eight.
day of JuLY , in the year of
ghai tr. Dugs
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
PGMÀ Hologram # 44999
